protocol.scope: Diagnostic qualification of inactive-writer observation overhead only; no retrieval-quality, production rollout, or provider parity claim.
protocol.control: Same candidate build, prepareRepositoryQualityContext with recordObservation false
protocol.candidate: Same candidate build, recordObservation true, selected event writer 1
protocol.fixture: One fixed initialized local repository, one 32 KiB Markdown candidate, one complete owner clause, no provider calls
protocol.coldDefinition: Fresh application process with no prior preparation; operating-system caches are not flushed
protocol.order: Alternate control/candidate and candidate/control within pairs
protocol.confidence: Paired percentile bootstrap, 10000 resamples, fixed xorshift32 seed 501, two-sided 95 percent interval
stopRules: Any changed semantic plan digest rejects the candidate
Any failed or cancelled process remains in the output and rejects qualification
Any privacy, unauthorized effect, stale-source success, or false evidence promotion stops rollout

measurementConditions: Shared developer workstation; operating-system caches and background workloads are not isolated
